relations: Ophelia 是 Dante 的 mate，刚缔结 mate bond；Dante 是吸血鬼之王。
Dante 派人把她的家当搬进庄园——她的房子太小、离 royals' mansion 不到十分钟。
Jazz 提醒过 Dante 必须每天进食才能保持状态。
Ophelia 是不卖作品的魔法陶艺师、堕落天使，坚称两人不是情侣。

facts.fact: Dante 停车熄火宣布她搬进来，绕车替她开门。
facts.anchor: Dante put the car in park, then turned it off.

facts.fact: Dante 告知已派人打包她的房子搬进庄园，陶器一件没碎。
facts.anchor: I had my people pack your house and move everything here. I warned them about the pottery, and nothing broke.

facts.fact: 一条无接缝玫瑰金手环扣上她的手腕。
facts.anchor: A thin, rose gold band was wrapped around my wrist without any visible seams

facts.fact: 手环摘不掉：矮人魔法，天使改不了，他问过了。
facts.anchor: "You don't. It's dwarven magic. Angels can't change it. I asked."

facts.fact: 她走上阳台双翼自行展开，怒气彻底消散。
facts.anchor: My wings unfurled of their own volition, the straps of my denim overalls

facts.fact: 阳台喂血：他搂腰吻喉缓缓深饮，这次没让她高潮。
facts.anchor: One of his arms slid around my waist, and his lips brushed my throat lightly

facts.fact: 橙色手机+新规：二十分钟不回短信就走心智 bond。
facts.anchor: You have twenty minutes to answer one of my texts, or I'll reach out

facts.fact: 当晚外卖意面她刮盘而尽，随后与 Dante 短信斗嘴。
facts.anchor: I ate the food, obviously. It was a pasta dish, and so delicious
